items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As an HRIS and People Data Specialist , you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of Betclic’s HR systems and people data. Working at the crossroads of HR, IT, and business teams, you will help transform people data into meaningful insights, support key HR processes, and contribute to building a stronger data-driven culture across the organization. YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: 1. HRIS Administration & Data Governance Act as a key user and subject matter expert for the HR Information System (HRIS). Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of employee data across HR platforms. Perform regular data quality audits and implement corrective actions when needed. Manage user access rights and coordinate HRIS-related support requests with internal IT teams and external vendors. Maintain HRIS documentation, processes, and user guidelines. Contribute to continuous improvement of HR systems and data governance practices. 2. HRIS Projects & System Enhancements Support the implementation and rollout of new HRIS modules and functionalities, including Recruitment, Onboarding, Performance and Talent Management. Gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications. Partner closely with HR, IT, and external vendors throughout project lifecycles. Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing (UAT), and post-go-live support. Drive adoption of new tools and processes across the organization. 3. People Analytics & HR Reporting Design, automate, and maintain HR dashboards and reporting solutions. Monitor key people metrics including headcount, turnover, absenteeism, diversity, recruitment, learning, talent, and compensation. Deliver regular and ad-hoc analyses to support HR and business decision-making. Ensure consistency, integrity, and relevance of HR data and reporting. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. 4. Support Key People Processes Support annual HR cycles through system administration and reporting: Performance Review campaigns Compensation and Salary Review processes Workforce Planning and Budgeting Talent and Succession Reviews Ensure data readiness and process efficiency throughout these cycles. 5. User Support & Enablement Train and support HR teams, managers, and employees on HR systems and reporting tools. Serve as a primary point of contact for HRIS-related questions and troubleshooting. Promote data-driven decision-making and best practices in HR systems usage. Contribute to the development of a strong HR data culture across Betclic. Next, you will meet Jessica (Total Rewards & People Operations Director) and Anne Claire (Head of People Operations) and performe a use case. Then you will meet one of our HR leaders. Finally, Benoit will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. THE ROLE: The Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful planning, execution, deployment, and ongoing operational delivery of Genius Sports products and services for customers. The role owns the customer delivery lifecycle from implementation and go-live through post-launch stabilization, seasonal readiness, and the activation of additional products and services. Working closely with Commercial, Product, Engineering, and cross-functional Operations teams, the Delivery Manager serves as the operational delivery lead for assigned customers, ensuring solutions remain healthy, operationally ready, and aligned with customer requirements throughout the partnership. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end delivery of customer implementations from project initiation through go-live, stabilization, and transition into ongoing operations. Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, resource plans, budgets, and delivery milestones. Coordinate cross-functional teams across Commercial, Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, Operations, Supply Chain, and Support, as well as customer teams and external stakeholders, to ensure successful end-to-end customer delivery. Serve as the primary operational delivery lead for assigned customers, building trusted relationships and acting as the main point of coordination for delivery-related activities. Monitor the operational health and performance of customer deliverables following launch, ensuring implementation commitments continue to be met. Lead the cross-functional resolution of complex, customer-impacting operational issues that occur during live service delivery, coordinating internal teams, managing stakeholder communications, driving decision-making, and ensuring timely resolution while minimizing customer impact. Coordinate and drive resolution of delivery-related issues by engaging the appropriate internal teams and managing communication with customer stakeholders. Lead seasonal operational readiness activities, including planning, testing, operational reviews, training coordination, venue readiness, and launch preparedness for new seasons and competition restarts. Manage the operational delivery of additional products, services, and customer enhancements for existing customers, ensuring successful planning, testing, deployment, and adoption. Coordinate customer change requests and ensure new capabilities are integrated into existing operational workflows with minimal disruption. Lead go-live planning, cutover activities, hypercare, and post-launch reviews to ensure successful service adoption. Track project and operational delivery milestones, proactively managing risks, dependencies, issues, and change requests throughout the customer lifecycle. Facilitate regular customer governance meetings, project updates, operational readiness reviews, and executive status reporting. Maintain accurate project documentation, implementation records, operational playbooks, and delivery reporting. Capture lessons learned following deployments, seasonal launches, and service activations, driving continuous improvement across delivery methodologies and operational processes. Ensure all customer deployments are delivered in accordance with company governance, quality standards, operational procedures, and contractual commitments. Identify opportunities to improve scalability, standardization, automation, and efficiency across the customer delivery lifecycle. Partner closely with internal cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience throughout implementation and ongoing operational delivery. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience managing complex customer implementations, technical deployments, or operational delivery within a customer-facing environment. Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent customer engagements and cross-functional initiatives. Strong customer-facing experience, including executive stakeholder management. Strong understanding and ability to apply project management methodologies. Proven experience managing project plans, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery governance. Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience working across global teams in a fast-paced operational environment. Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar project management tools. IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU KNOW Experience within sports technology, broadcast technology, SaaS, media, or enterprise software. Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent). This role offers an annualized salary of up to $120,000 USD and includes eligibility for Genius Sports Group’s benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius . Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

THE TEAM Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers. We are looking for a Platform Product Manager to join our Payward Services team. This is a builder: someone who can own a product roadmap end to end, go deep on how a flow actually works, and ship regulated B2B2C products (KYC/KYB, lending, unified APIs) from concept to launch. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the product roadmap and build-out for our B2B2C platform products (KYC/KYB, lending, unified APIs) - Defining requirements, partnering with Engineering on execution, and driving products from concept through launch and iteration. - Get hands-on with the product itself: how a flow works, where it breaks, what needs to change to make it scale, and what it takes to bring it to market in a regulated environment. - Drive cross-functional execution with Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to turn roadmap priorities into shipped product. - Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure new product builds meet regulatory requirements as part of the design and build process, rather than as a downstream gate. - At a high level, support the operational functions tied to our US regulated entities as needed to keep product work moving. WHAT YOU BRING - Strong product management experience: you've owned a roadmap, shipped B2B or B2B2C products, and can speak fluently to product strategy, requirements, and execution. - Direct, hands on experience implementing KYC, either building it in house or standing up a KYC solution to resell or offer to external parties. NICE TO HAVES - Experience working at a KYC/KYB service provider. - Crypto or digital assets experience, in industry or through regulated product launches, including familiarity with crypto native operations (treasury and custody). - Former founder or early product hire at a fintech or crypto startup. items.description: Perplexity is seeking an Applied AI Architect to help our customers turn Perplexity Computer into working solutions that drive measurable impact. This role is ideal for technical, consultative professionals who have led complex software implementations and can move comfortably between customer discovery, solution design, hands-on delivery, and executive communication. About the role Perplexity Computer is a new class of AI system that navigates tools, interacts with applications, and completes multi-step workflows end to end. Our customers are using Computer to transform work that traditional software has not been able to address. Applied AI Architects work directly with customers across presales, onboarding, adoption, and strategic engagements. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the intersection of solutions architecture, technical consulting, and program delivery. You will work closely with Sales and Customer Success while serving as a quality filter for requests that require Product or Engineering. What you'll do - Lead technical discovery. Work with customer business leaders, technical teams, account executives, and customer success managers to understand the users, current workflow, desired outcome, constraints, and decision-makers. - Design credible solutions. Map how people, data, tools, approvals, permissions, and decisions interact, then determine how Computer can support the workflow. - Support complex opportunities. Partner with account executives on technical deal strategy, demos, proofs of value, architecture and security coordination, and engagement scoping. - Drive value-backed consumption. Identify high-value, repeatable workflows; define the expected business outcomes and usage patterns; and partner with Sales and Customer Success to move customers from technical validation to sustained production use and expansion. - Build hands-on. Establish scope, customer commitments, milestones, success criteria, working cadence, and exit criteria, then lead the work through closure. - Improve technical escalation. Validate product and engineering needs and produce decision-ready requests with clear evidence, constraints, impact, and acceptance criteria. - Turn every engagement into leverage. Convert repeated customer needs into reusable workflows, implementation patterns, demos, guidance, and product feedback. What we're looking for The strongest Applied AI Architects combine technical depth, consultative problem solving, and disciplined engagement delivery. You should be comfortable working hands-on with the product, advising customer executives, and managing the details required to deliver a successful outcome. Must-haves - 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, senior sales engineering, AI implementation, forward deployed work, technical consulting, or technical program leadership. - Proven consultative discovery skills. You can turn an ambiguous request into a clear business problem, technical approach, and delivery plan. - Hands-on technical fluency. You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, authentication, identity, permissions, connectors, data flows, and technical troubleshooting. - Experience delivering complex implementations. You have managed scope, stakeholders, milestones, risk, expectations, and closure. - Strong solution judgment. You can distinguish education, configuration, implementation, support, product, and engineering problems and recommend the right path. - Commercial and consumption awareness. You can connect solution design and technical decisions to time to value, usage, credit consumption, customer economics, and expansion potential. - Executive-credible communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to senior decision-makers while working effectively with practitioners and engineers. - High agency in ambiguity. You can establish direction without waiting for perfect requirements, challenge weak assumptions, and make thoughtful decisions quickly. - AI-native working style. You use frontier models and AI tools regularly and have developed strong intuition for what current systems can and cannot do reliably. Nice-to-haves - Experience deploying agents or multi-step LLM workflows in complex enterprise environments. - Experience with Computer, MCP, enterprise identity, security, permissions, or workflow orchestration. - Experience in regulated or workflow-intensive industries such as legal, financial services, healthcare, or technology. - Prior forward deployed engineering, Applied AI, deployment strategist, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience at an AI or enterprise software company. - A track record of turning customer implementations into reusable technical assets or product improvements.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's billing surface is growing fast. New products, new regions, and new channels all need to be metered, priced, invoiced, and reconciled, and the work to make that happen crosses billing engineering, GTM systems, finance, and support teams. Today much of it runs on escalations rather than programs. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the cross-functional programs in this space. You'll partner closely with billing engineering, GTM systems, finance and treasury, product, and support, and give leadership a single clear view of priorities, dependencies, and progress. Responsibilities Drive the cross-team programs that build billing platform foundations, from scoping and tradeoff decisions through delivery Standardize how new commercial work enters billing: a framework driven intake, clear owners, and sequenced dependencies across billing teams and their stakeholders Own the promotions program end to end: one repeatable path from proposal to configuration to reconciliation, for both self-serve and sales-led programs Own commercialization and launch readiness for billing: no new product or SKU launches without pricing, metering, invoicing, and reporting in place Own the change process for the charge pipeline Run payments operations programs in partnership with finance and treasury, including currency and FX You may be a good fit if you Have 6+ years of technical program management experience, with a track record of owning cross-functional programs end to end Can reason about metering, invoicing, and payment flows, and the data pipelines behind them Have run launch readiness programs where a new product needed its commercial and billing path in place before it shipped Can build trust with engineers, finance and treasury partners, GTM systems, product, and support teams, and translate between them Are comfortable driving outcomes across teams that don't report to you Would rather build a repeatable process than keep fixing the same problem by hand Strong candidates may also have Experience with promotions or credit programs or enterprise billing platforms Familiarity with FX, treasury, month end close, or reconciliation Background in payments operations, billing platform, or quote-to-cash product management Familiarity with chargeback and refund operations The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Trade Surveillance Associate, Derivatives
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Trade Surveillance Associate in the Market Regulation Department of Coinbase Derivatives, LLC (CDE), this is a hands-on trade surveillance role where you'll help ensure the integrity of Coinbase's CFTC-registered designated contract market by monitoring trade activity, investigating potential violations, and enforcing CDE's rulebook. Working closely with the Chief Regulatory Officer and Market Regulation Department, you'll analyze surveillance alerts, conduct investigations into disruptive trading practices, and produce the reports and documentation that support CDE's regulatory obligations as a self-regulatory organization. What you'll do: Investigate potential trade practice violations, including spoofing, wash trading, money pass activity, front running, fraud, and other disruptive trading activity by CDE participants to ensure compliance with CDE's rulebook and applicable CFTC regulations. Analyze alerts generated by CDE's trade surveillance system, triaging and escalating matters that require heightened review in partnership with Market Regulation Department leadership. Produce investigative reports documenting observations, findings, and assessments, maintaining compliance with recordkeeping requirements for all inquiries and investigations. Deliver updates and presentations to the Chief Regulatory Officer, CDE Board, and Regulatory Oversight Committee on matters related to trade activity in accordance with CDE rules and procedures. Identify patterns and trends across surveillance data that may indicate emerging market risks or systemic compliance gaps, recommending process improvements to strengthen the program. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience providing market and trade surveillance support for regulated entities (DCMs, DCOs, exchanges, broker-dealers, or comparable). Sound understanding of market fundamentals, derivatives trading practices, and investigative and surveillance techniques, with the ability to apply CFTC regulations and exchange rulebooks to specific trading scenarios. Demonstrated ability to produce clear, well-organized investigative memoranda, reports, and presentations that synthesize complex trading data for stakeholders at all levels, including regulators. Experience managing multiple concurrent investigations and regulatory deadlines while maintaining accuracy and thoroughness across all active matters. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . items.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives)
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Mountain View
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team partners closely with customers to help them turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across strategy, solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies. The Digital Natives segment serves technology and software companies that are building AI into the core of their products and businesses. These customers are often highly technical, move quickly, and are among the earliest adopters of OpenAI’s newest capabilities. Our Applied AI Engineers work directly with their engineering, product, and technical leadership teams to identify high-impact opportunities, solve complex technical challenges, and bring ambitious AI applications into production. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives) to lead the team responsible for the technical success of our most strategic technology and software customers in the Americas. In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers who work hands-on with customers to design, build, evaluate, and scale AI applications. You will help determine where deep technical partnership can unlock the greatest customer and business impact, while developing repeatable approaches that allow the team to support a broad and fast-moving customer segment. As a manager, you will set the strategy and operating model for the team, coach and develop engineers, and serve as a senior technical partner to customers and internal stakeholders. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Research to connect what we learn from customers with OpenAI’s product direction and help customers take advantage of our newest capabilities. Success in this role will be measured by meaningful production applications, sustained adoption and usage, strong customer outcomes, and technical patterns and insights that can be applied across the broader Digital Natives segment. This role is open in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own the strategy and operating model for the Digital Natives Applied AI Engineering team, ensuring alignment with OpenAI’s objectives and the evolving needs of technology and software customers. - Lead, hire, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing Applied AI Engineers responsible for delivering meaningful technical and customer outcomes. - Guide the team in working hands-on with customers to identify high-impact use cases, design and build AI applications, solve technical challenges, and scale successful solutions into production. - Partner closely with Sales to prioritize technical engagement across strategic customers and identify where Applied AI Engineering can unlock adoption, usage, and long-term customer growth. - Serve as a senior technical partner and escalation point for priority customers, building trusted relationships with engineering leaders, CTOs, and other executive stakeholders. - Represent the technical voice of Digital Native customers by synthesizing insights around model performance, developer experience, product gaps, emerging use cases, and technical blockers for Product, Engineering, and Research. - Translate recurring customer needs and successful implementations into repeatable technical patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, tooling, and best practices that allow the team to scale its impact. - Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership. - Help customers understand and apply OpenAI’s newest capabilities, identifying opportunities to build differentiated products and experiences with frontier models. - Champion the safe, reliable, and effective application of OpenAI’s technology across the Digital Natives ecosystem. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a member of the US Talent Acquisition team focused on Sales and Go-To-Market hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's US-based revenue-generating teams from the ground up. Joining early means you'll help shape both our GTM recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with GTM leadership across Sales, Pre-Sales/Solutions, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. Your work will directly influence our commercial success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional operators who will drive Mistral's growth in the US market. In this role, you'll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish GTM recruiting best practices as we expand across the US. What You Will Do GTM Stakeholder Partnership - Partner deeply with GTM leaders — from CRO and VP Sales to Pre-Sales and Customer Success leadership — to understand hiring needs, define role specs, and identify the right commercial talent. - Own full-cycle recruitment across all GTM functions: AEs (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB), SDRs, Solutions/Sales Engineers, Partner Managers, CS leaders, and RevOps - Advise hiring managers on market mapping, leveling, comp positioning, and competitive landscape for US GTM talent - Translate the nuances of each GTM role into compelling, accurate candidate outreach End-to-End GTM Recruitment - Own the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing to close, operating with autonomy on complex, high-volume GTM roles. - Source passive and active candidates across US GTM talent pools, particularly in AI/ML, open-source software, and enterprise infrastructure markets - Conduct intake and calibration sessions with hiring managers to align on ideal candidate profiles and stage expectations - Drive efficient, high-conversion pipelines and close candidates in a fiercely competitive market for senior GTM talent Candidate Experience & Selling Mistral - Guide candidates through the hiring process with clear communication and a compelling narrative about Mistral's mission, culture, and trajectory. - Articulate Mistral's positioning in the AI landscape — frontier models, open-weight philosophy, and enterprise credibility — to differentiate us against better-known competitors - Provide candidates with real insight into our GTM motion, growth plans, and the specific impact of their role - Deliver a high-quality, respectful candidate experience at every stage, regardless of outcome Recruiting Operations & Data-Driven Improvement - Develop and refine GTM recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency. - Use data to diagnose pipeline issues (e.g., drop-off at specific stages, time-to-fill by role) and propose targeted solutions - Build and maintain market maps, competitive intel, and talent pools for key US GTM segments - Standardize GTM interview rubrics, scorecards, and debrief practices across US GTM hiring teams Raising the Bar - Collaborate with GTM leadership and the broader Talent team to continuously elevate our hiring standards. - Contribute to defining and evolving our GTM talent acquisition strategy in the US as we scale from early commercial team to mature GTM org - Partner on employer-brand and outbound sourcing initiatives that position Mistral as a destination for top GTM talent What We're Looking For - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth B2B SaaS/infrastructure company, with a focus on Sales and GTM roles - Demonstrated ability to independently hire across the full GTM stack — from SDRs to senior AEs, Solutions Engineers, and GTM leadership - Deep network and sourcing expertise in US GTM talent markets, particularly in AI/ML, open-source, developer tools, or enterprise software - Track record of hiring in competitive, candidate-scarce markets where GTM candidates have multiple offers - Experience working across multiple US markets - Willingness to work on other roles as needs come up - Comfort navigating ambiguity and switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence peers and senior GTM stakeholders without direct authority - Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle shifting priorities across a high-volume hiring slate - Professional experience with modern recruiting tools such as Ashby - Familiarity with the AI/ML landscape and the ability to credibly discuss frontier model capabilities with technical GTM candidates WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Corporate Development Integration Lead
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic is seeking a Corporate Development Integration Lead to own the critical post-signing phase of our M&A activity — from confirmatory diligence through integration planning to full operational follow-through. As Anthropic's corporate development function matures and transaction volume increases, this role will serve as the connective tissue between deal teams, product and engineering organizations, and the acquired teams themselves, ensuring that acquisitions deliver on their strategic thesis. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of M&A execution and operational excellence. You will define and scale the integration playbook, build repeatable processes for technical and organizational integration, and work directly with executive leadership to ensure each deal realizes its intended value. The ideal candidate has deep prior integration experience at high-growth technology companies and brings a structured, hands-on approach to navigating the complexity that arises after a deal signs. You are energized by turning strategic intent into operational reality. You thrive working across organizational boundaries, are comfortable operating in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, and understand that integration is where M&A value is ultimately created or destroyed. Join us in building the infrastructure that ensures Anthropic's acquisitions create lasting value — both for the mission of safe AI and for the brilliant teams we bring into the organization. This role offers a rare opportunity to shape how one of the most consequential companies in AI executes and integrates its growth strategy. Key responsibilities Lead confirmatory diligence workstreams post-LOI, coordinating with legal, finance, product, engineering, and research teams to validate the strategic and technical thesis before deal close Develop and maintain due diligence frameworks tailored to Anthropic's acquisition types (acquihires, technology acquisitions, transformational deals), ensuring consistent and thorough assessment of technical assets, talent quality, IP, and organizational fit Own the integration readiness assessment — identify risks, flag cultural or operational gaps, and provide go/no-go input to deal sponsors before signing Coordinate technical deep dives with engineering and research leadership to validate product-market fit, code quality, and team capabilities Design and own end-to-end integration plans for each transaction, covering organizational structure, reporting lines, tooling migration, product roadmap alignment, and day-one operational continuity Build and maintain a scalable integration playbook, establishing best practices, templates, and decision frameworks that can be reused across future deals Develop integration timelines and milestones in close coordination with product, engineering, HR, IT, and legal to ensure cross-functional alignment before and at close Facilitate introductions and relationship-building between acquired teams and internal stakeholders during the planning phase to accelerate ramp and reduce post-close friction Model financial and operational scenarios to stress-test integration assumptions and identify contingency plans Drive day-one and day-100 integration execution, tracking milestones against plan and escalating blockers to deal sponsors and executive leadership in real time Serve as the primary point of contact for acquired teams during the transition period, ensuring they have the information, access, and organizational support needed to be productive and retained Partner with HR and people managers to design onboarding and retention plans for key talent, with particular focus on acquired engineering, research, and product leaders Conduct post-integration retrospectives to capture lessons learned, measure outcomes against the original deal thesis, and feed insights back into future integration planning Build and report integration KPIs to leadership, including retention rates, product milestone achievement, and operational readiness benchmarks Minimum qualifications Possess strong technical fluency — either through prior software engineering or product experience, or deep familiarity with evaluating technical organizations and codebases Are skilled at building cross-functional relationships and can effectively coordinate across product, engineering, legal, HR, and finance teams Excel at translating strategic objectives into actionable operational plans with clear timelines, owners, and accountability Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can maintain both urgency and precision when managing multiple parallel workstreams Have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present integration status and recommendations clearly to executive leadership Are genuinely excited about AI safety and aligned with Anthropic's mission to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems Preferred qualifications Have 10+ years of corporate development or M&A integration experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading post-acquisition integrations at high-growth technology companies Have direct experience in AI/ML companies or deep learning research environments, with an understanding of the unique talent dynamics in frontier AI Have built or significantly contributed to a corporate development integration function, including the creation of playbooks, frameworks, and repeatable processes Bring experience with acquihire integrations, including deep familiarity with technical talent retention and the unique challenges of integrating small, high-output engineering teams Have an MBA or advanced technical degree (Computer Science or equivalent) Demonstrate experience managing stakeholder expectations across multiple simultaneous integrations with competing timelines Possess experience with international or cross-border transaction integration, including navigating differing cultural norms and regulatory requirements The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $325,000 — $425,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Director of New Business
items.description: Grandstand is the intelligence layer powering informed decisions for consumers and partners across sports, gaming and entertainment, with a portfolio that includes Gambling.com, Casinos.com, OddsJam, RotoWire, Bookies.com and Spotlight.Vegas. The Director of New Business drives new commercial growth across the North America market. This is a hands-on sales role with a clear mandate: identify, win and close new commercial relationships across the region, and develop them into high-value partnerships. You will sell the full breadth of what Grandstand offers — not a single product — building your own pipeline, structuring deals that work for both sides, and turning first conversations into lasting senior partnerships. New Business and Market Growth Win new commercial business. Identify, pursue and close new commercial relationships applicable to all US P&Ls across the group. Build the pipeline that makes growth predictable rather than opportunistic. Sell the full Grandstand suite. Know the complete range of technology and inventory Grandstand has to offer — B2B affiliate partnerships, advertising inventory and premium placements, adtech integrations, fintech products, sports data services and our B2C consumer products — and take the right combination to each partner. Extend our reach through partners. Identify media owners, platforms and partners whose audiences can be monetized through Grandstand's operator relationships, technology and demand, and structure commercial models that work for both sides. Open new revenue lines. Identify adjacent categories, verticals and partner types the group is not yet monetizing, and make the commercial case for pursuing them. Build and run the pipeline. Maintain a qualified, forecastable pipeline with clear stages, conversion expectations and rigorous hygiene. New Business Strategy Shape the go-to-market. Map the operators, advertisers and partner types the region should be pursuing, prioritize targets by revenue potential and strategic fit, and build the outreach plan to convert them. Structure winning deals. Design affiliate and advertising deal structures for new partners within the region's pricing framework, and bring a clear commercial recommendation when a deal needs an exception. Deliver the number. Hit your new business target, keep a pipeline accurate enough for your VP to forecast from — coverage, conversion and timing — and flag risk to the number early. Connect new business to the sites. Align new partnerships to each site team's US revenue plan so wins land where they move the number most. Partnership Development Build and cultivate new relationships. Open doors with new operators and advertisers, cultivate those relationships from first contact, and develop them into high-revenue-generating senior partnerships. Own the early lifecycle. Ensure new partners are onboarded well, communicated with proactively and see value quickly — from signature through first renewal. Protect the economics. Monitor the performance of the deals you close, address underperformance early, and recommend where to invest, restructure or step back. Show up in the market. Represent Grandstand at industry events and conferences, and build the presence that keeps the pipeline warm. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Tech, Marketing and Content. Work with these teams to deliver the integrations, marketing materials and assets partners need, optimize campaign performance, and bring back the market feedback that shapes what they build next. Influence product and data. Feed operator and market intelligence into product and commercial planning so our offering stays ahead of where the market is going. Operate within the compliance framework. As part of a publicly listed company, ensure all commercial activity meets our legal, financial and regulatory obligations — contracts through legal review, deals within approval and financial reporting controls, and advertising, licensing and responsible-gambling standards met in every jurisdiction we operate in. What You Will Bring 5+ years of commercial experience in online gambling, sports betting, affiliate marketing or adjacent digital media. A demonstrable new business record. You have personally won and closed commercial deals, not only grown accounts you inherited. An established network of relationships across the North American iGaming and media industry, and the ability to activate it quickly. Fluency in affiliate commercial models (CPA, revenue share, hybrid, flat fee) and the confidence to negotiate them. The range to sell a multi-product suite — performance partnerships, media and advertising inventory, adtech, fintech and data — and package them into one commercial story. Strong commercial analytics: comfortable working in the numbers to diagnose performance and build a case. Professional presence — credible with operator stakeholders, internal teams and at industry events. Nice to Have Experience standing up commercial coverage in a newly regulated market. Exposure to B2B data, adtech or audience monetization products in addition to affiliate. How Success Is Measured New business won. Number and value of new operator and advertiser relationships closed in the region. [Target to confirm] Contribution to regional growth. Measurable increase in the group's North America revenue and margin across the portfolio. Partner development. Growth and retention within the partnerships you bring in. Pipeline health. Coverage, conversion rates and forecast accuracy. items.title: Deployment Strategist - DHS/DOJ
items.description: Scale is building AI for the world’s most important decisions. From the front lines of homeland security to the core of global enterprise, we provide the data engine and agentic infrastructure that powers the next generation of American and allied interests. As a Deployment Strategist supporting DHS and DOJ, you will be responsible for bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and mission-critical production. You will lead the charge in deploying Agentic AI, autonomous reasoning systems, into the heart of homeland security and law enforcement workflows, ensuring that some of the nation’s most consequential decisions are supported by the world’s best technology. Deployment Strategist (DHS/DOJ) We are looking for a powerhouse executive account leader who understands that winning at DHS and DOJ isn’t about a successful 6-month pilot; it’s about becoming an enduring, funded capability inside a component’s operational baseline. You will focus on landing and transitioning high-stakes prototypes into full-scale enterprise deployments, navigating the complexities of the Valley of Death by securing executive sponsorship and programmed funding. Responsibilities: This is an individual contributor role with heavy leadership expectations. You are the "CEO of the Account," responsible for the following: Full-Spectrum Capture & Quota Ownership: Carry and exceed a multi-million dollar annual revenue quota. You are responsible for the entire lifecycle: from identifying the top of funnel opportunity and shaping requirements to the final contract award and revenue recognition. Tactical Execution: You don’t just delegate; you execute. You will personally draft high-impact white papers, lead the development of complex proposals, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of federal civilian contracting, including OTAs, GSA schedules, and component-specific IDIQ vehicles. Operational Transition: Once the deal is signed, your job isn’t over. You will continue to lead the account, ensuring that the delivery team (Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, and Product) enables mission success. You are the primary point of contact for the customer, ensuring the pilot doesn’t just work, but scales. Renewal, Expansion, & Growth: Own the long-term account strategy. You are responsible for identifying the next use case, securing the follow-on funding, and driving the 10x growth that turns a single component deployment into a department-wide enterprise standard. Direct Agentic Solutioning: Work in the weeds with technical teams and end-users to co-design Agentic AI workflows. You must be able to translate a customer’s vision into a specific technical requirement that our engineers can build against. SI & Prime Orchestration: In partnership with Scale’s Partner Managers, you will actively manage and negotiate with Tier 1 Systems Integrators and federal primes to ensure Scale is the agentic AI engine of their larger programs. You will be the lead negotiator for sub-contracting and teaming agreements. Requirements: Experience: 10+ years of experience in complex enterprise IT sales or business development, specifically within DHS, DOJ, or the broader federal law enforcement and homeland security market. Proven Track Record: You have successfully closed and implemented multi-year deals exceeding $25M. You know how to get a line item in the budget. Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of DHS and DOJ modernization priorities, specifically in AI/ML, computer vision, biometrics, screening and vetting, investigative analytics, or case management. The Valley of Death Navigator: You have a demonstrated ability to transition technology from "cool demo" to "deployed capability" within a major component program office. Strategic Network: Existing high-level relationships across DHS and DOJ components (CBP, ICE, USCIS, TSA, CISA, FBI, DEA, ATF, USMS) and their CIO and enterprise IT organizations, as well as a Rolodex of contacts at the major federal integrators. Clearance: Active Secret clearance is strongly preferred; TS/SCI and existing component suitability are a plus. Education: BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA preferred. Geography: Based in the National Capital Region, with the ability to work out of Scale’s D.C. office 2-3 days a week. Travel: Ability to travel 20-30% of the time. Who you are: Mission-Driven: You believe that whoever wins in AI wins the next century, and you want that to be the United States and its allies. Relentless: You thrive in the long-game of defense procurement. You aren't discouraged by bureaucracy; you see it as a puzzle to be solved. Adaptive: You can operate in the high-velocity environment of a Series E startup while maintaining the polish required for the Pentagon. The Closer-Operator: You have the executive presence to brief a PEO. Radically Accountable: You don't wait for a marketing lead or a BD specialist to hand you a deal. You build your own funnel, navigate the "No's," and find the creative path to "Yes." Technically Credible: You aren't a software engineer, but you can explain the difference between RAG and Agentic reasoning to a skeptical technical evaluator. Sales Commission: This role is eligible to earn commissions. The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of San Francisco, New York, or Seattle is [ ]. Compensation packages at Scale include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position, determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, interview performance, and relevant education or training. items.title: Operating Systems Engineer | Consumer Devices
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, and cloud services to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an Operating Systems Engineer to build and harden the OS foundations for OpenAI products. We are especially interested in experienced, passionate, and innovative operating systems developers who thrive on building foundational platform software and solving hard problems in security, privacy, performance, power, and reliability. You will work across the OS kernel, core OS services, security and privacy primitives, performance and power, and the frameworks that connect applications and UI to the system. This role emphasizes deep debugging and systems ownership from development through production. You will collaborate closely with embedded, firmware, hardware, application, and product engineering teams. Experience with hardware bring-up is a plus, but not required. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Work on end-to-end OS capabilities spanning the OS kernel, userspace services, application frameworks, UI toolkits, and application-facing APIs. - Develop, integrate, and maintain OS components, both kernel-bound and in userspace, including scheduling, memory management, filesystems, drivers, IPC/RPC mechanisms, and security-relevant subsystems. - Build and maintain core OS services and daemons (init, service management, device discovery, networking primitives, time, logging, update hooks, crash handling, and so on). - Design and implement security and privacy mechanisms: - Secure boot and measured boot integration points (where applicable). - Mandatory access control and sandboxing. - Secrets management, secure storage, key handling, and least-privilege service design. - Privacy-preserving telemetry, data minimization, and user-consent oriented system behaviors. - Establish a performance and power discipline: - Instrumentation, profiling, and regression detection for boot time, latency, throughput, and memory. - Power measurement workflows, battery and thermal aware tuning, and energy regression prevention. - Build first-class debugging and observability for the OS: - Tracing and profiling using tools such as ftrace, perf, eBPF, BPFtrace, LTTng, systemtap, flamegraphs. - Crash triage and root cause analysis across kernel and userspace, including postmortem tooling and symbolication. - Provide stable, well-documented platform interfaces for application frameworks and UI frameworks: - Windowing/compositing primitives (e.g., Wayland), input pipelines, graphics stack integration (e.g., DRM/KMS), and UI performance. - System APIs for permissions, notifications, background execution, storage, device access, and lifecycle management. - Contribute to reliability and release readiness: - Production hardening, incident response participation, and cross-team debugging. - Test strategy across unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop environments; improve coverage and reduce flakiness. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Strong experience with systems programming (such as with Linux, BSD, etc), including meaningful work in the kernel (drivers, core subsystems, or platform enablement) and operating systems. - Professional proficiency in C, C++ for low-level systems development. - Experience building or maintaining core OS services and platform software (system services, daemons, init/service management, device management, logging/telemetry pipelines). - Track record of debugging complex issues across kernel/userspace boundaries using tracing, profiling, and structured root cause analysis. - Familiarity with security fundamentals in OS design: isolation boundaries, privilege separation, secure IPC, attack surface reduction, and vulnerability mitigation practices. STRONGLY PREFERRED - Production experience with Rust in systems contexts (kernel-adjacent tooling, userspace services, security-sensitive components, or performance-critical libraries). - Experience with OS security hardening: SELinux/AppArmor policy, sandboxing, seccomp, namespaces/cgroups, secure boot chains, exploit mitigations. - Experience setting up and operationalizing observability: eBPF-based tooling, perf pipelines, automated regression detection. - Performance and power optimization experience, including measurement methodology (power rails, battery instrumentation, thermal constraints) and closed-loop tuning. - Experience supporting application or UI frameworks at the OS boundary (Wayland/compositors, graphics pipeline performance, input latency, lifecycle/permission models). NICE TO HAVE - Hardware bring-up exposure (bootloader/early boot debugging, device tree/ACPI, board revisions, peripheral enablement), even if not your primary background. - Experience with OTA/update systems, partitioning strategies, rollback/health checks, and update security (signing, provenance). - Experience contributing to upstream open source projects (Linux kernel, system components) and managing long-lived downstream patches responsibly. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - The OS is secure by default, privacy-preserving, and designed for least privilege. - Performance and power characteristics are measurable, repeatable, and continuously improved with low regression rates. - Debugging is fast: tracing, logs, crash artifacts, and metrics make issues diagnosable in development and in the field. - Application and UI teams have stable, well-documented system interfaces that enable high-quality product experiences. WORKING STYLE - You take ownership across boundaries: kernel, services, tooling, and the interfaces that applications rely on. - You are comfortable making careful tradeoffs between security, privacy, performance, power, and developer velocity. - You communicate clearly with partner teams and can translate low-level findings into actionable changes. You’ll manage our marketing portfolio and intake process, lead selected cross-functional projects, and build AI-enabled tools that make it easier for marketers to get their work done. You’ll be the first partner for new requests: understanding the business need, sizing the work, and finding its best home. This role combines an integrated marketing mindset with hands-on project management and a builder’s instinct. You should enjoy being the person everyone reaches out to, making sense of ambiguity, and seeing how a small ask might become a much bigger thing—or when a big ask is actually something quite small. This role makes everyone’s life a little easier by providing a better understanding of what’s happening across the entire department, a clear way to kick off work with the right people, high-touch support for our most intense projects, and useful systems that take friction out of everyone’s day. Use team feedback and delivery patterns to simplify processes, strengthen self-service, and reduce repetitive coordination. Build systems that remain useful as the team and volume of work grow. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a builder who can translate legal and operational complexity into clear, practical solutions. Reporting to the Head of Global Mobility & Immigration, you will partner with the broader team and lead through expertise and influence across Legal, Corporate Development, Recruiting, People, Finance, business teams, and external counsel to turn emerging business needs into scalable programs, policies, and durable controls. What you'll do - Set the roadmap, principles, governance, and operating model for priority global mobility and immigration initiatives. - Lead the U.S. permanent residence strategy, including PERM planning, controls, communications, compliance and continuous improvement. - Own immigration and mobility workstreams for M&A, divestitures, restructurings, entity changes, and new-market entry—from diligence through integration. - Lead global expansion strategy, ensuring work authorization, business travel, and compliance in rapidly growing international jurisdictions. - Build reusable playbooks, decision frameworks, risk assessments, and change-management plans. - Partner with Legal, Corporate Development, Recruiting, People, Finance, and business leaders to identify implications early and drive sound decisions. - Establish dashboards and program-health measures covering compliance, cycle time, quality, cost, vendor performance, and employee experience. - Manage external counsel and vendor partners through clear service levels, quality standards, budgets, and outcomes. - Use systems, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve case handling, documentation, communications, and leadership visibility. items.title: Product Manager, Multimodal Safety
items.description: About the Team Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives—from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming—all aimed at mitigating misuse, misalignment, and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations. About the Role We are hiring a Product Manager to focus on risk related to multimodal models. In this role, you will drive initiatives which ensure that OpenAI’s audio, image, and video deployments are safe, impactful, and aligned with user needs and technical innovation. You will clarify strategic priorities, develop safety-focused product roadmaps, and collaborate closely with AI researchers, software engineers, policy experts, and cross-functional partners. This role suits a proactive, technically skilled product manager adept at adversarial thinking and excited to tackle challenging, ambiguous problems through structured analysis and collaborative decision-making. This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available. In this role, you will: - Partner closely with AI research, engineering, data science, policy teams, and other stakeholders to embed safety throughout the development and deployment of multimodal AI models - such as GPT-Live https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live/ and ChatGPT Images https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-images-2-0/ - as well as multimodal capabilities in frontier AI models. - Develop comprehensive frameworks for understanding and mitigating deployment safety risks, drawing on data analysis, expert consultation, and adversarial assessments. - Define strategic priorities and product roadmaps focused on improving deployment safety, enhancing reliability, and managing multimodal AI capabilities. - Create scalable approaches for evaluating and improving safety outcomes. - Establish repeatable processes to integrate cutting-edge AI safety research into OpenAI’s models and product offerings. - Develop and continuously refine clear, actionable metrics that effectively capture safety performance and user experience at scale. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of product management or related industry roles, with specific expertise in AI safety, trust & safety, integrity, or related domains. - Are deeply curious and interested in interdisciplinary fields such as human-computer interaction, psychology, philosophy, or similar areas. - Have hands-on experience driving consensus and action in ambiguous spaces. - Excel at identifying and challenging underlying assumptions and constraints through insightful questioning. - Are highly effective at cross-functional collaboration and communicating complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively. - Enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. items.title: Growth PM
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Growth PM to own data and growth experimentation across the full funnel, from landing page through to in-app and pricing. ElevenLabs drives significant paid and organic traffic across self-serve, developer, and enterprise funnels; your job is to turn more of it into subscriptions, pipeline, and revenue. You'll own the experimentation engine end to end: uncovering opportunities through funnel and product data, building and prioritizing the testing backlog, designing and evaluating experiments, and owning the tracking and reporting that turns results into decisions. Your scope runs deeper than conversion optimization: you'll drive experiments across onboarding, activation, and pricing, and align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around one optimization roadmap. The ideal candidate is equal parts analyst, strategist, and operator: someone who finds revenue hiding in funnel and product data, ships a high-velocity testing program, and communicates results in terms of subscriptions and pipeline, not just conversion rates. REQUIREMENTS - A track record of running high-velocity experimentation programs end to end - hypothesis, prioritization, test design, and analysis - with measurable revenue impact - Experience running experiments beyond the marketing site: in-product (onboarding, activation) and pricing or monetization - Deep analytics fluency: comfortable living in product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude, GA4) to diagnose funnel drop-off, segment traffic, and attribute outcomes across multi-domain journeys - Strong statistical literacy: you know how to size tests, avoid false winners, and choose the right success metric (revenue and subscriptions over clicks) - A cross-functional operator who can align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around a shared optimization roadmap Bonus - Working front-end web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) to build test variants without waiting on engineering - Experience optimizing PLG/self-serve funnels alongside sales-assisted (demo/contact-sales) funnels LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw. #Li-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
